name: pets
description: Pets (docs/proposals/pets.md): an animal that lives in somebody's home. A pet is its NPC (flags.pet names its row), which the engine already lists, describes, sends home and lets you pet, plus a row in `pets` holding its body (the cat kit's numbers) and personality. Answers the Room Stage's roomstage.npcBeast hook so the stage draws the NPC as the cat instead of a person, with its nature, its bowls and whatever beat it's on. What a cat does on its own is client/shared/cat-life.js, from its id and the clock, including which piece of furniture it's up on and its goes at its bowls; this plugin says it in the room as it changes, so the text and the 3D cat agree. Its beats are RAM: it greets whoever comes in (zone.entered) at the door they came through and waits to be stroked, and it claims `pet` (npc.petAttempt) to purr, then warn, then swat whoever keeps going; `pet <cat> <where>` (the engine hands the spot over: chin, cheek, head, ears, back, tail, paws, belly) weighs on that ladder by what the spot is to a cat, and ROOM sends it as you stroke him with the mouse. A feeding station (furniture with flags.pet_bowls) holds two meals and a day's water; `refill` fills it at a small price for what's gone. How hungry and thirsty a pet is comes from when its bowls were last filled (cat-life.js catNeeds), worked out when read: hungry at an empty dish it pesters, greets people by demanding food, and says so when examined (npc.describeAnimal); thirsty at an empty bowl it drinks from the kitchen tap. A litter tray (furniture with flags.pet_tray) is scooped with `scoop`, free; how dirty it is comes from when it was last scooped and the cat's own times, and a full one he goes beside and the room smells of it (zone.smells). Carers, bond and the other pet verbs are still to come.

refill.note: Flag-gated on a pet's feeding station (flags.pet_bowls): a declaration-only specialized action advertises REFILL on its examine, furniture.acts puts it on the piece in ROOM, and the handler finds the station in the room itself.

scoop.note: Flag-gated on a pet's litter tray (flags.pet_tray): a declaration-only specialized action advertises SCOOP on its examine, furniture.acts puts it on the piece in ROOM, and the handler finds the tray in the room or its en-suite itself.
